stem:
Derrick drew two congruent figures and then shaded \( \frac{1}{4} \) of each figure.
Which figures could be the ones Derrick drew and shaded?

options.label: A
options.text: Two circles each divided into 4 parts; one has a quarter shaded on the top left, the other has a quarter shaded on the bottom right.

options.label: B
options.text: Two rectangles, one divided into 4 parts and the other into 6 parts, with a single part shaded on the left side for each.

options.label: C
options.text: Two circles each divided into 5 parts; one has a shaded part on the top left, and the other has a shaded part on the right.

options.label: D
options.text: Two rectangles with 5 parts shaded; one is vertically divided into 5 equal parts with one shaded on the right, the other is divided into 5 horizontal parts with one part shaded on top.

visual_elements: Four pairs of shaded figures labeled A, B, C, and D showing different configurations of shaded parts in congruent shapes.
difficulty_rationale: Understanding congruency and fractional shading in different shapes requires modest reasoning to eliminate incorrect options; it is more than one concept but does not involve multi-step complex calculations.
